correctness.rationale: For nonzero neighbor sum, each vertex has a unique type-dependent best response, and for zero sum all actions tie. The four disjoint (S_A zero/nonzero, S_B zero/nonzero) cases give the exact four-term formula; all boundary cases a,b>=1, including degree-one and balanced types, are included. Exact rational binomial-sign symmetry gives the fair random-type law. Independently iterating direct payoff inequalities across 400 type-count configurations and 102400 action-profile tests (a,b<=5), plus 64 exact-rational side-size probability tests (a,b<=8), reproduced the formula; the general claim relies on the analytic proof, not finite experiment.

value.rationale: Fixed dense bipartite social interactions are a natural two-population game architecture. The complete exact multiplicity classification over all sizes and arbitrary type compositions is an intrinsic structural invariant with no arbitrary cutoffs; it reveals the sharp universal even-even existence guarantee, odd-odd fair-type nonexistence probability exactly 1/2, and exponentially many minimum equilibria when both sizes are even. These facts discriminate equilibrium robustness by side parity rather than merely repeating generic PNE existence statements; the 2026 role-segregated special case motivates this gap.
